description: Several red strings lie on a yellow bedspread, with both hands hovering nearby. The right hand picks up a loose strand on the right and crosses it over the center while the left hand steadies the bundle, then the left hand alternates by pulling a left strand across as the right hand shifts to grab the next strand, repeating these over-under passes to braid the strings into a tighter, twisted column before briefly loosening and re-crossing to continue the braid.
